description.value: The study investigated anxiety-related neural changes after internet-delivered cognitive behavior therapy for social anxiety disorder, compared with attention bias modification, using pre- and post-treatment fMRI during an affective face processing task.

spans.text: The present study aimed to investigate neural changes, measured during an emotional face processing task ( ), following internet-delivered CBT for SAD in comparison to an active control condition using ABM.

value: We hypothesized that a positive treatment outcome would be associated with attenuated amygdala reactivity.
We expected to find increased activity in prefrontal regions (e.g. dlPFC, mOFC, rACC, vmPFC) in relation to decreases in amygdala.
